SELECT USER_NUM as userNum, USER_EMAIL as userEmail, USER_NAME as userName, USER_NICKNAME as userNickname, USER_TYPE as userType, USER_REGISTER_DATE as userRegisterDate, USER_IS_DELETED as userIsDeleted, BLOCKED_DATE as blockedDate FROM T_USER
USER_TYPE != 'ADMIN'
AND (USER_EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR USER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND BLOCKED_DATE > SYSDATE
AND (BLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR SYSDATE >= BLOCKED_DATE)
ORDER BY USER_NUM DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
